# Techexperten om Anthropic: "Ingen jätteframgångsrik notering"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Henrik Ek, the guest tech reporter, says Anthropic's IPO was not very successful. It came out at a lower valuation than first planned, the stock rose about 17% and then gave some of that back, and it listed at a bad time with tech sentiment weak. He calls the company operationally strong, but its customers can switch models easily and listed-company pressure may conflict with its focus on safety. The host Ulf describes a volatile, sentiment-driven US market with 10% swings; the episode also covers OpenAI's IPO timing, Nvidia's earnings, the GTA release and its effect on other games companies, plus sponsor ads for PostNord and AMF.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ANTHROPIC — Anthropic | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest doubts the IPO was a success; bad timing, selling pressure at the open, would be worried if he had bought a lot yesterday.

#### Reasoning

Guest Henrik Ek sees Anthropic as operationally excellent with the most popular LLM. But the IPO came at a valuation cut in rounds and at the worst possible time for tech, with selling pressure at the open that could spiral. Longer term, customers such as Lovable are model-agnostic, so stickiness is limited, and listed-company pressure may force trade-offs on safety. He says it 'will go very well' operationally but is cautious on the stock in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- selling pressure after listing continues
- OpenAI overtakes on model quality
- customer churn becomes visible in reporting
- tech sentiment keeps deteriorating

> *"Jag skulle vara lite orolig om jag köpte jättemycket Anthropic igår."*
